input: Find a local chess club to join on weekends

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing the user's city or neighborhood is essential to finding geographically relevant clubs — without a location, no search can begin.
Chess clubs vary widely — some are casual drop-in groups, others are competitive/tournament-focused. The type of club determines which options to prioritize.
Some clubs cater to specific age groups (juniors, seniors, adults). Knowing who the user is — or who they are finding the club for — narrows the right fit.
Many clubs charge membership fees or require equipment. A budget limit affects which clubs are realistic options.
The user's skill level (beginner to advanced) shapes which club environment they would thrive in and enjoy.
Weekend availability varies — Saturday morning vs. Sunday afternoon affects which clubs actually fit the user's schedule.
What the user ultimately wants from joining — socializing, improving their game, competing — determines what 'the right club' actually looks like.

gold.taskTitle: Find and join a local weekend chess club
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate and sign up for a chess club in their area that meets on weekends.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood are you based in?
questions.description: Identifies the user's location so the search can be geographically targeted.

questions.title: Are you looking for casual play or competitive tournaments?
questions.description: Determines the type of club environment — relaxed social games vs. rated/tournament-level play.

questions.title: What is your current chess skill level?
questions.description: Helps match the user to a club suited to their experience, from beginner-friendly to advanced.

questions.title: Which part of the weekend works best for you?
questions.description: Pinpoints whether Saturday, Sunday, mornings, or afternoons fit the user's availability.

questions.title: Is this club for yourself or someone else, like a child?
questions.description: Identifies the intended participant to filter for age-appropriate clubs (junior, adult, mixed).

questions.title: Do you have a budget for membership or club fees?
questions.description: Determines whether paid memberships or free community clubs are the right target.

questions.title: What do you most hope to get out of joining a club?
questions.description: Clarifies the user's primary goal — socializing, skill improvement, competition — to define what a successful find looks like.
